input.prompt: Static medium close-up from inside the shadowed bedroom looking toward the single doorway, framing the Military Husband front-on as he crosses the threshold. Heavy charcoal curtains, brass bedside lamp glow, cream plaster walls, and dark hardwood floor edge the frame, while the camera slowly pushes toward his face as he stops dead. The location is the place shown in @Image1: keep its architecture, furniture, materials, colors and light exactly the same, but film it from the camera angle described here, not the angle of the picture. Characters: Military Husband is @Image2 (Tall, athletic Western European man in his early 30s with short dark-blond hair, blue eyes, clean-shaven face, strong jawline, and a neatly fitted dark military dress uniform with polished black boots.). [0.7s to 4.3s] Military Husband speaks in the voice of @Audio1, barely steady, voice thinning as each word catches: "No. Please, no. This can't be happening to me." Military Husband is clearly visible on camera, face and lips in view, while speaking. Natural lip sync: each person's lips move only during their own line; everyone else keeps their mouth closed. His smile vanishes. His eyes widen and stop blinking, his mouth stays slightly open, and his shoulders lock in place. The clear glass vase shifts from behind his back to his side, gripped hard enough that his knuckles pale. No background music.
